en.question: Why should I tell the pharmacist or doctor about all medicines I already take?
en.answer: Different brand-name medicines can contain the same active drug, such as paracetamol, or interact dangerously with one another. Sharing your current medicine list protects you from accidental double dosing.

yo.question: Kí ló dé tí mo fi gbọ́dọ̀ sọ gbogbo oògùn tí mò ń lò fún oníṣègùn?
yo.answer: Orúkọ oògùn méjì ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀ lè ní èròjà kan náà bíi paracetamol, tàbí kí wọ́n má ṣe bára wọn mu. Sísọ gbogbo oògùn tí o ń lò fún dókítà ń dènà lílo oògùn pọ̀ jù.

pcm.question: Why I must tell doctor or pharmacist all the drugs I dey take already?
pcm.answer: Two different medicine names fit get the exact same ingredient inside, like paracetamol, or dem fit clash for body. Showing all your drugs dey stop accidental overdose.
